title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents with Dynamic Connection and Evolution
exact_overlap: Structured extraction and memory note linking
difference_to_test: A-MEM lacks explicit file-hash validity scopes, role-projected bonus, and cross-model handoff invalidation

title: AgeMem: Unified Long-Short Term Memory Management for Autonomous Agents
metric: Task Success Rate, Memory Footprint, Token Efficiency
exact_overlap: Memory consolidation and temporal decay mechanisms
difference_to_test: AgeMem uses continuous decay rather than strict artifact-hash validity and role-specific views for handoffs

title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Dynamic Context and Experience Memory in Realistic Agentic Workflows
task: Long-term multi-session software tasks with requirement shifts
metric: Stale Information Error Rate, Handoff Success Rate
exact_overlap: Knowledge updates, stale statement detection under requirement shifts
difference_to_test: LongMemEval-V2 is an evaluation benchmark; RoleMem is a concrete evidence-scoped role-projected retrieval mechanism

title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
exact_overlap: Temporal updates and user preference tracking
difference_to_test: Evaluates conversational QA, does not evaluate code handoffs, role projection, or programmatic task execution

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
exact_overlap: Paged memory retrieval and self-editing tools
difference_to_test: MemGPT uses tool-call memory editing without evidence scope, explicit artifact-hash invalidation, or role views

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
task: Code generation, Web navigation, Math reasoning
exact_overlap: Self-reflection on failed attempts within episodic memory
difference_to_test: Reflexion accumulates text reflections without role projection, supersedes chains, or cross-model handoff scoping

title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
exact_overlap: Scoring retrieval via recency, importance, and query relevance
difference_to_test: Lacks task-oriented evidence validity, conflict handling, and role-conditioned retrieval for code handoffs

title: AgentRunbook: Synthesis and Retrieval of Structured Operational Knowledge for Code Agents
task: Repo-level code maintenance and task transfer
exact_overlap: Structured operational steps with preconditions and postconditions
difference_to_test: AgentRunbook is static/synthesized procedures; RoleMem dynamically scopes validity over evolving artifacts and projects to Coder/Reviewer roles
